title: When Are Nesterov Trajectories Eventually Locally Minimizing?
abstract: arXiv:2610.33341v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We revisit the variational characterization of Nesterov's celebrated method and study when Nesterov trajectories are eventually locally minimizing in a variational sense, a notion that we define precisely. We show that this question is equivalent to the nonnegativity of an associated Schr\"odinger operator acting on variations of the trajectory. For power objectives of the form \[ f(x)=\frac{1}{p}\|x\|^p \] (where $\| \cdot\|$ denotes the Euclidean norm), we give a complete characterization: Among all exponents $p\ge 2$, the Nesterov trajectory with non-zero initial position is eventually locally minimizing if and only if $p=4$. We further interpret this exceptional exponent through the stability theory of semilinear elliptic equations.

translated_title: Nesterov 轨迹何时具有最终局部最小化性质？
translated_abstract: 我们重新审视了 Nesterov 著名方法的变分刻画，并研究了 Nesterov 轨迹在变分意义下何时具有最终局部最小化性质——这是一个我们精确定义的概念。我们证明，该问题等价于一个相关的薛定谔算子作用于轨迹变分时的非负性。对于形如 f(x)=（1/p)‖x‖^p 的幂函数目标（其中 ‖·‖ 表示欧几里得范数），我们给出了完整的刻画：在所有指数 p≥2 中，具有非零初始位置的 Nesterov 轨迹具有最终局部最小化性质当且仅当 p=4。我们进一步通过半线性椭圆方程的稳定性理论来解释这一特殊指数。
tldr: 本论文将 Nesterov 轨迹的最终局部最小化问题等价转化为相关薛定谔算子的非负性问题，并证明对于幂函数目标，在所有指数 p≥2 中该性质当且仅当 p=4 成立，且这一特殊指数可由半线性椭圆方程的稳定性理论解释。
